_notes: Registry of OPEN-WEIGHT / non-Anthropic models for the Phase 0 screen (run-id: openmodels01).
Mirrors config/models.json. Keys are the short names used by --models on runner/openmodels_phase0.py.
ALL model IDs verified live against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on 2026-08-03 (337-model catalog).
Access is via OpenRouter using the `openai` python client with base_url=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
OPENROUTER_API_KEY must be in .env (gitignored).
PROVIDER/QUANT CONFOUND (important, read before citing any cell): OpenRouter routes to third-party
providers that serve the SAME model at DIFFERENT quantizations (glm-4.6 is served fp4 by Venice/Z.AI,
bf16 by Novita, fp8 by AtlasCloud). Quantization plausibly moves a marginal attractor. The runner
therefore PINS one endpoint per model (provider.only + allow_fallbacks:false), preferring the highest
precision available (bf16 > fp16 > fp8 > unknown > mxfp4 > fp4 > int4), and records the served provider
+ quantization on EVERY record. Pins are resolved live by `--ping` and written to the run manifest,
not hardcoded here, because provider availability churns.
LINEAGE BUCKETS ARE ORGANIZING LABELS, NOT CLAIMS. 'suspected Claude-flavored' records COMMUNITY
REPORTS of Claude self-identification in these model families; it is speculation, not established fact,
and Phase 0 is designed to test it via idiosyncratic-error fingerprints rather than assume it.
See openmodels_interp_program.md 'standing caveats' — a shared GENERIC George error proves only a
shared web prior, since the 'It's not a lie' meme is George-coded across the whole open web.
NOT AVAILABLE (checked 2026-08-03, kept here so nobody re-researches them):
allenai/olmo-3-32b-think  — in the catalog but 0 live endpoints. The best data-transparent control
(open training data => can literally grep the corpus for the George meme).
Get it locally in Phase 1 instead; it is the single most valuable control.
google/gemma-2-9b-it      — NOT served by OpenRouter. This is the Gemma Scope SAE target; gemma-2-27b-it
is served but only int4 by one provider (too degraded for a knowledge gate).
Phase 1 runs the Gemma-2 SAE work locally regardless, so this is not blocking.
meta-llama/llama-3.1-405b-instruct — DELISTED from OpenRouter (only nousresearch/hermes-3-llama-3.1-405b
remains, a fine-tune, unsuitable as a Meta-lineage control). Roster uses
llama-4-maverick-class / llama-3.3-70b instead.

defaults._temperature_note: null => provider default, recorded per call from the echoed request. Prereg §4.4 parity.
defaults._tools_note: NO TOOLS, EVER, in this run. Several of these models are served with search-augmented variants elsewhere; a search-backed correct answer would destroy the parametric-recall measurement (crossmodel01 lesson).

S7_logprob.purpose: OPTIONAL: forced-choice token logprobs = P(Jerry) vs P(George). Phase-1 metric preview, no GPU needed. Only on s7_eligible models. NOTE: the `logprobs` flag below records that OpenRouter ADVERTISES logprobs for the model — verified 2026-08-03 that this does NOT mean the serving provider returns them (of 5 llama-3.1-8b endpoints, 3 return an empty array and 1 returns only the terminal token). The runner therefore probes empirically for a logprob-capable endpoint per model and pins S7 to it separately from the behavioral pin; if none works, S7 is skipped for that model and the skip is printed and recorded. Also: S7 runs at temperature 0, so its n=3 is a provider-determinism check, not statistical power.

kimi-k2-0905.note: ERA-MATCHED to the study period and the specific Kimi release carrying the most community reports of Claude self-identification. 1T-param MoE — behavioral only, never an interp target.

kimi-k2-thinking.note: Reasoning sibling of k2-0905. bf16 available => the cleanest-served model in bucket A. Reasoning trace is recorded (open-model traces are interp-adjacent data we never get from closed models).

kimi-k3.note: Current Moonshot flagship (post-cutoff for the assistant's knowledge; nothing assumed about it). Tests whether any bucket-A signature PERSISTS into the current generation or was era-specific.

glm-4.6.note: ERA-MATCHED. WIDEST quant spread in the roster (fp4 to bf16) — pinning matters most here; prefer Novita bf16.

glm-5.2.note: Current Z.ai flagship. No bf16 endpoint seen — pin fp8 and record the limitation.

deepseek-v3.note: V3 chat. Non-reasoning => the cleanest 4.7-side (lure-acceptance) probe in bucket B.

deepseek-r1.note: Era-matched reasoning model. Tests P4 (heavily-RL'd reasoning => 4.8-side wrongful contradiction).

deepseek-v4-pro.note: Current DeepSeek flagship, 18 endpoints. Generation-matched partner to kimi-k3/glm-5.2.

qwen3-235b.note: Non-reasoning instruct => S7 logprob cell works without a reasoning prefix. bf16 available.

llama-3.3-70b.note: CLEANEST control: Meta lineage, no Claude-distillation reports, weights genuinely open, bf16 served. Doubles as the Phase-1 mid-size ladder anchor (runs on one H100 node).

llama-3.1-8b.note: PRIME Phase-1 interp target if it passes the knowledge gate: Llama Scope pretrained SAEs exist, TransformerLens support, runs on a single 24GB GPU. Expected to FAIL the gate (that is itself the decision-relevant result -> gate G2).

qwen3-32b.note: Hybrid-reasoning; dense 32B, interp-viable on one 80GB GPU. s7 disabled because reasoning is on by default and would consume the forced single token.

gemma-3-27b.note: Google-family knowledge probe. If Gemma-3-27b passes the gate, Gemma-2-9b (the Gemma Scope SAE target, run LOCALLY in Phase 1) is worth screening locally too.
